gate.proposal_header: | Choice | Proposal | Core scene | Action & expression | Composition | Visual settings / text | Recommendation |
gate.proposal_question: **Which proposals should I generate?** Pick one or more. Recommended: {choices}.
gate.proposal_strategy: **Strategy:** each selected proposal yields 1 image by default; you can also say, for example, "two of A, one of C". After you choose, I will summarize settings, counts and candidate budget, and generate only after you confirm.
gate.subject: Subject / action / composition
gate.native: provider-native resolution (1024×1024 recommended for square, not required)
gate.budget: Candidate estimate: {images} × {per_image} = {estimate}; approved run ceiling: {run}; at most {per_provider} per provider per image.
gate.raised: **This exceeds the usual 24-candidate budget; confirming also approves the raised ceiling above.**
gate.route: Providers: Codex ImageGen first (outside Codex, through the local Codex CLI, using ChatGPT plan quota) → OpenAI → Nano Banana → Seedream.
gate.location: Default output: artifacts/whalechan-image-character/{run}/ (or a directory you specify).
gate.question: **Start generating with the proposals, counts, settings, candidate budget and sub-agent plan above?**
gate.serial_execution: Execution: no sub-agents; the main agent generates and checks serially.
gate.parallel_execution: Execution: start **{count} sub-agents**, each handling one image at a time and taking the next task when done; the main agent verifies and archives everything. Parallelism does not add images or candidate budget. If capacity drops, you will be told and the count lowered; exceeding the confirmed count needs a new confirmation.
gate.canonical_style: Clean rounded linework and cel shading
gate.canonical_costume: a navy-and-white maid outfit with a white frilled headpiece and blue bow
